name: Privilege Milk Cleanser (100 ml)
headline: Milk Cleanser
description: A creamy milk cleanser with coffee oil and extract that dissolves makeup and daily grime while leaving the skin soft and comfortable. The gentle first step of the Privilege routine.
howToUse: Morning and evening, massage over dry or damp skin, then rinse or wipe off with a cotton pad.

manufacturing.expiration: 3 years from the date of manufacture; 12 months after opening
manufacturing.storage: Store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight.
manufacturing.ingredients: Organic aloe vera leaf juice, sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate, glycerin, cocamidopropyl betaine, phenoxyethanol, disodium cocoamphodiacetate, arabica coffee oil, glycol distearate, PEG-150 pentaerythrityl tetrastearate, sodium chloride, caprylyl glycol, caprylyl/capryl glucoside, lauryl glucoside and other components.
